profile.heading: Hello, I'm Felipe, a Software Developer with over 4 years of experience in Web Development.
profile.p1: During this time, I've had the opportunity of working with large companies, fast paced startups, and delivering tailored solutions to freelance clients.
profile.p2: Specializing in Typescript, React, and Node.js, I craft interactive and responsive web applications. I am committed to delivering solutions that are both high-performing and aesthetically pleasing.

blocks: Built applications with over 100.000 monthly users.
Lead front-end development teams on projects with global reach.
Delivered end-to-end solutions to freelance clients, including project, creation and deployment.
